scripts.build:android: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:release: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:ios:ipa: export LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 && npx cap sync ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -archivePath build/Mori.xcarchive archive CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" && mkdir -p Payload && cp -r build/Mori.xcarchive/Products/Applications/App.app Payload/ && zip -r "Mori v4.5.2.ipa" Payload && rm -rf Payload build
